name: chess-desktop
description: Chess Website desktop application built with Electron and React

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron ."
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron .
